description: The user changed a prompt set in the Prompts tab: the whole set as the user left it. A new id adds a set. Only deleted: true removes one.

id.description: The set's id; each starter set has a fixed one, so two devices never add it twice.

name.description: The set's name, such as Evening review.

occasion.description: A short label for when the set is meant to be used, such as Morning, Evening or Hard moment; empty when none.

basedOn.description: The book the set is based on and its author, as people read it, such as The Happiness Trap, Russ Harris; empty when none.

prompts.description: The prompts, the questions the user answers, in the order they are asked.

position.description: The set's place in the list: a key that sorts by plain comparison, the list in ascending order (5).

deleted.description: True when the user deleted the set. False when absent.
